This operation provides the mechanism for user registration within the Todo List system.

It accepts a user's email address and password, validates that the provided email is unique (as enforced by the unique constraint on the email field in the todo_list_users table), and securely stores a hash of the user's password in the password_hash column. No plain-text passwords are ever stored; all password security requirements are dictated by strong hashing as noted in the schema's password_hash comment.

Upon successful creation of the user account, the system issues a signed JWT containing the new user's id (from todo_list_users.id), role, and associated permissions determined by their registration as a user. Session information is also established for auditing and session expiry (linked through peripheral tables).

Security is managed through unique email enforcement, proper hashing, status checks on is_locked (to immediately lock any account if necessary), and audit-compliant timestamp fields created_at and updated_at. The account remains locked if system rules require it (e.g., for compliance or abuse).

This endpoint is the entry point for all new user onboarding and triggers follow-up flows like login, password reset, or account management. All expected errors (duplicate email, hashing failure, invalid input) return clear, safe messages. Related endpoints: login, refresh, or user password reset.

All failed authentication attempts are securely logged, and if required by business rules, may increment a failure counter and/or trigger lockout (via is_locked) if abuse/threats detected. If the user is locked, authentication fails gracefully with a clear error.

ITodoListUser.IAuthorized.description:
Authorization result DTO for Todo List end-user authentication flows (join, login, refresh).

This structure delivers authentication tokens along with all safe-to-expose user context, encapsulated in the 'user' property as a summary of account essentials. The root level holds only authentication/session artifacts ("token") and a current snapshot of user state in 'user' – never duplicate or raw sensitive fields.

Used as the atomic backend result for new user creation, login, or refresh operations. Application code must always display user information exclusively from the nested 'user' summary, treating it as the single source of UI/account context. This separation ensures a DRY and future-proof contract in accordance with backend security requirements and frontend clarity.

See documentation for IAuthorizationToken and ITodoListUser.ISummary for details on tokens and user context.

id.description: User's unique identifier (UUID), assigned at account creation. Used as the primary key in the todo_list_users table.

email.description: User's unique login and contact email, used for communication, identity, and authentication. Must be unique for each user in the system.

is_locked.description: Account lock status. True if the user account is suspended or disabled due to abuse, compliance, or admin action. Locked users cannot login or perform actions.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the user account was first created in the system.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of most recent account update (such as email change or lock status).

user.description: Summary of the authenticated user session. Represents the user's minimal account and status context as sourced directly from the todo_list_users table. Used as the authoritative frontend source for identity/role/sign-in status and system identity.

ITodoListUser.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a registered end user, mapped directly from the todo_list_users table in the Todo List system. This summary variant is used for lists, lightweight user context, and inclusion as a user snapshot in authentication and session DTOs.

Reflects the service's strict privacy controls: never exposes password hashes or internal system fields, and only transmits email, account status, and unique identifier. Auditing and compliance metadata is handled via session and audit tables, not here.

Optimized for both personal and administrative UI listings; suitable for main menu displays, session overlays, and high-trust minimal referencing by other API contracts.

All properties are mapped directly from the primary fields of the todo_list_users schema.

id.description: Unique identifier for the registered user, as sourced from todo_list_users.id. This is a system-generated UUID assigned at registration and serves as the main user reference in all relations.

email.description: Globally unique email address for user authentication and communication. This field is strictly enforced to be unique across the todo_list_users table, and is required for all user-facing operations. Used as the login identity, for notifications, and for account recovery flows.

is_locked.description: Account lock or suspension status as tracked in todo_list_users.is_locked. True indicates the user is currently suspended or disabled due to administrative action or abuse detection; false means active. Determines authentication and access permission in all session flows.

ITodoListUser.ILogin.description:
DTO schema for user login (authentication) in the Todo List system.

This request body is used when a user attempts to authenticate by providing their credentials. It contains the email address (which must be globally unique) and the user's password, which is received as plain text for validation and hashing purposes (never stored as plain text). This DTO does not and must not expose any identity or system fields, matching security-first requirements and business constraints.

Used exclusively in the user login API operation for credential validation and system login. Password is always plain string. All system fields (id, session, status) are derived server-side and never provided by the client. Follows best practice for password handling and authentication flows.

email.description:
End user's globally unique email address for login. This must be provided by the user, and will be checked as the primary identifier in todo_list_users.

Validation: must follow RFC 5322 email format. Example: user@example.com.

password.description: End user's password in plain text form for login authentication. The password will be checked against the stored, securely hashed password in todo_list_users (via password_hash field). Minimum 8 characters. The backend is responsible for hashing and secure verification. Never exposed or stored in plain text beyond this check.

ITodoListUser.IRefresh.description:
DTO schema for requesting a refresh of JWT tokens for an authenticated user session in the Todo List system.

This schema is used by the API when a valid refresh token is provided and a new JWT (access & refresh pair) must be issued. The only required property is the refresh token string that was previously issued; all session and user context validation occurs server-side. Never contains system identity or user fields, for strict security and separation of concerns.

refresh_token.description: Opaque refresh token string issued by a previous login or registration operation. Must be provided in full as received. Used to look up and validate existing session. Example: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1N...'. Minimum 32 characters for security.

email.description: Globally unique administrator login email address for access and communication purposes. Must conform to RFC 5322 email format and is validated for uniqueness at the schema and application layers.

password.description: Plain text password used for administrator account registration. Must satisfy system-configured password policy. The password is only accepted here for registration and is never stored in plain form; it is cryptographically hashed and persisted in the password_hash field in the database.

oneOf.description: IP address of the registration requestor for session audit trail, if available (can be IPv4 or IPv6).

ip.description: IP address of the admin registration operation, if available. This field supports both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses or can be null if not captured by the client or server. Used in session context, audit, and security analysis.

href.description: Absolute URL of the page where the registration request originated. Used for session context and audit purposes. Must be a valid absolute URI (RFC 3986). Technically required by session policy.

referrer.description: The referring page URL which led to this admin registration request. Used for audit and session contextualization. Required by security compliance policy and must be a valid absolute URI (can be empty string for direct navigation).

ITodoListAdmin.IJoin.description:
DTO for registering a new administrator account in the Todo List system.

Accepts a unique email (which also serves as the login credential) and a strong password (to be hashed server-side upon creation). Records session context including originating IP address (optional), connection URL (href), and referring URL (referrer).

The password field is for plain text only and must meet system complexity requirements—never stored in the database without hashing. Registration call always attaches creation and update metadata automatically; admin is unlocked at creation. Session-related context used for auditing and compliance.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authorized administrator account registered or authenticated in the Todo List system. Corresponds to the primary key in 'todo_list_admins'.

email.description: Administrator's unique contact email. Used for login and notifications. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

is_locked.description: Indicates whether the admin account is locked and disallowed from performing actions. Used for security suspension and access revocation.

created_at.description: Date and time when the admin account was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the admin account, for audit and compliance purposes.

ITodoListAdmin.IAuthorized.description:
Response DTO representing an authorized administrator session after registration or authentication.

Includes the unique administrator account identifier and issued token(s) to be used as Bearer credentials for access to protected admin endpoints. The token structure adheres to security standards and enables tracking of admin privileges, permissions, and session context.

This type is always returned upon successful registration or login, and may also be issued during token refreshes for ongoing session management.

email.description: Administrator login email address. Must match a registered admin's email from 'todo_list_admins'. Used as unique identifier for privileged login.

password.description: Plain password for authentication. Compared against the stored hash ('password_hash') in 'todo_list_admins'. Must not be empty.

oneOf.description: Login IP address in IPv4 format.
Login IP address in IPv6 format.

ip.description: IP address where admin logged in to begin session. Used for auditing, security monitoring, and session context. Optional; typically extracted by backend if omitted.

href.description: The URL of the page where the login attempt originated. Used for session context and audit trails. Required for new session creation.

referrer.description: The referring URL for the login request. Tracks session chain and audit trails. Required for session creation for compliance.

ITodoListAdmin.ILogin.description:
Request DTO for administrator login in the Todo List service.

Carries admin credentials and session context (connection metadata) for authentication. Email must match an 'todo_list_admins' record; password is compared to stored hash. Provides session audit context through href and referrer fields, with optional explicit IP.

Successful login results in session creation in 'todo_list_admin_sessions'.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token associated with an active admin session, previously issued by the login operation. Must reference a valid, unexpired 'todo_list_admin_sessions' record.

ITodoListAdmin.IRefresh.description:
DTO for refreshing administrator authentication tokens in the Todo List service.

Carries the refresh token issued after a successful login, which must be linked to an active and valid 'todo_list_admin_sessions' record. Used to obtain new access tokens without resubmitting credentials.

Session validity, lock status of the admin, and session expiration are checked as part of refresh. Fails if the session is expired or revoked.

id.description:
Primary key of the system settings record.

Globally unique identifier for each configuration entry, used for precise referencing and lookups at the database layer. Managed by the backend system, not editable by users.

key.description:
Unique setting identifier for system-wide configuration.

This is a business-meaningful symbolic string that identifies a specific global feature, flag, or parameter (for example, 'max_login_attempts', 'enable_signup'). This is the business primary key for platform configuration settings, and must be unique. Indexed for rapid retrieval by key. The system enforces max length 100.

value.description:
Configuration value associated with the given key, stored in string format.

This field encodes the setting's value as a string; application logic is responsible for interpreting as int, boolean, etc. Max length 1024; longer strings will be truncated or rejected.

description.description:
Optional human-readable description for this system setting.

Provides service administrators or platform operators additional context, business meaning, or operational warnings for the configuration parameter. Used for documentation or in management UIs only.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this configuration entry was created.

Set automatically by backend (ISO 8601, UTC). Used for audit/history and cannot be updated post-creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this system setting was most recently modified.

Set automatically by backend upon any update (ISO 8601, UTC).

ITodoListSystemSetting.description:
Represents a single global configuration setting for the Todo List service.

Each entry defines an individual system-wide feature flag, operational threshold, or infrastructure parameter. Used by platform administrators to adjust runtime behavior, enable or disable global options, or document available settings. All relationships are internal; no foreign keys. Timestamps are managed by the backend for auditability and change tracking.

key.description:
Business-meaningful identifier for the global setting being created.

Represents the unique symbolic key for this system configuration entry (e.g., 'max_login_attempts', 'enable_signup'). System will reject attempts to create duplicate keys.

value.description:
String-encoded configuration value for this setting.

The backend will store values as string; application logic must interpret as needed (int, boolean, etc.). Field validation ensures maximum 1024 characters.

description.description:
Optional explanation, documentation, or operational context for this platform setting.

Used for service admin reference in the UI or operational documentation, not consumed by usual business logic.

ITodoListSystemSetting.ICreate.description:
Create DTO for registering a new global configuration setting for the Todo List system.

Used by privileged platform administrators to register a new system-wide configuration parameter, feature flag, or threshold. Key must be unique—duplicates trigger error. Description is optional and for admin/UIs only.

value.description:
New value (string-encoded) for the target configuration key.

This field is mandatory when updating a system setting. The value may be interpreted as int, boolean, etc. by business logic. Max length 1024 enforced.

description.description:
Optional updated explanation or doc-text for the setting.

Can be set to null or a new string to revise the admin-facing note for this setting. No effect on business logic.

ITodoListSystemSetting.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for modifying the value or description of an existing global system setting by key.

Allows system administrators to update the string value (mandatory) and/or the explanation (optional) for any configuration setting. The setting key is in the path, not this body schema.

ITodoListSystemSetting.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a Todo List platform-wide system setting.

Used to display basic information about service-level configuration parameters, without including sensitive operational metadata. Typically used in lists or lookups of all current platform settings. Each summary includes the setting identity, value, and high-level documentation for clarity in administrative interfaces.

This is a lightweight variant that omits detailed audit or versioning fields, focusing on rapid reference for platform operators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the system setting (database primary key in UUID format).

key.description: Unique string identifier (business key) for the configuration parameter. Used as the authoritative name for retrieving or updating settings. E.g., 'max_login_attempts', 'enable_signup'.

value.description: String value assigned to this configuration setting. Interpreted by the backend for various platform options. Always stored as string regardless of intended application-level type.

description.description: Detailed administrative description or documentation for the setting. May be null if no explanation is provided. Used to clarify purpose, allowed values, defaults, or operational caveats for platform operators.

ITodoListSystemSetting.IRequest.description:
Query parameter body for filtering, sorting, and querying system settings in administrative APIs.

May specify key, time range, description, or sort order. All fields are optional, allowing maximum flexibility for administrator search/filter use cases. Used by PATCH /todoList/admin/systemSettings.

key.description: Filter by exact or partial (contains) setting key. If set, only records matching key (or substring) are returned.

description.description: Find settings containing this text in the description field. Enables full-text or partial search by context note, recommended for scenarios where operational or documentation context is known.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort results. Use in conjunction with order. Allowed values: key, created_at, updated_at.

Direction to sort results. Allowed values: asc for ascending, desc for descending. Defaults to 'asc' if omitted.

order.description: Direction to sort results. Allowed values: asc for ascending, desc for descending. Defaults to 'asc' if omitted.

created_to.description: Filter settings created at or before this timestamp (ISO 8601, UTC).

updated_from.description: Filter settings updated at or after this timestamp.

updated_to.description: Filter settings updated at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum record count per page (default 20, maximum 100).

ITodoListUser.description:
A registered end user in the Todo List system.

This schema represents a single user account as persisted in the todo_list_users Prisma model. It includes non-sensitive business and system fields such as email, account lock status, and timestamps, but intentionally omits sensitive password hash material and system authentication fields for security and privacy reasons.

This type is used in API responses where the full user entity must be exposed to the user (usually for their own information), supporting account/profile queries and updates. Account management is strictly private: only the user themselves can retrieve or modify their own record. All access and changes are subject to least-privilege and auditing policies.

id.description: User's unique identifier (UUID), assigned at account creation. Used as the primary key in the todo_list_users table.

email.description: User's unique login and contact email, used for communication, identity, and authentication. Must be unique for each user in the system.

is_locked.description: Account lock status. True if the user account is suspended or disabled due to abuse, compliance, or admin action. Locked users cannot login or perform actions.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the user account was first created in the system.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of most recent account update (such as email change or lock status).

ITodoListUser.IRequest.description:
Request body schema for advanced search, filtering, and pagination of end user accounts in administrative API endpoints.

Allows platform admins to submit flexible queries against the todo_list_users table. Supported fields include partial email matches, account lock filter, date range filters, and pagination controls. This type mirrors admin search backend requirements and enables list APIs to efficiently filter and paginate large user datasets.

Sensitive data and password hashes are never accessible or queryable through this request DTO. Only platform admins may submit such queries in production. Rate limits and paging limits should be enforced in API usage.

email.description: Optional substring or full email address to filter users by partial match or exact search. Uses case-insensitive matching.

is_locked.description: Optional filter for account lock status. When true, only locked (suspended) users are included. When false, only unlocked (active) users.

created_at_from.description: Start of creation date range (inclusive, UTC). Only users created on or after this time are included.

created_at_to.description: End of creation date range (inclusive, UTC). Only users created on or before this time are included.

updated_at_from.description: Start of last update date range (inclusive, UTC). Only users updated on or after this time are included.

updated_at_to.description: End of last update date range (inclusive, UTC). Only users updated on or before this time are included.

page_size.description: Number of users per page (default: 20, max: 100).

oneOf.description: Sorting key for search results. Must be one of: created_at, updated_at, or email.
Sorting key for search results. Must be one of: created_at, updated_at, or email.
Sorting key for search results. Must be one of: created_at, updated_at, or email.

sort_by.description: Sorting key for search results. Must be one of: created_at, updated_at, or email.

oneOf.description: Result sort order. asc for ascending, desc for descending.
Result sort order. asc for ascending, desc for descending.

sort_order.description: Result sort order. asc for ascending, desc for descending.

email.description: New email address for the todo list user account. Must be globally unique. Changing the email updates the user's login and contact details. Value must follow standard RFC 5322 email format and application uniqueness constraints. Update is optional, and field is omitted if not changing email.

password.description: New plaintext password to set for the user account. Plain password will be hashed and stored per password security policies. If provided, must be at least 8 characters, subject to server-enforced validation (no common or easily guessed passwords, recommended use of letters, numbers, symbols). Leave undefined if password change is not desired.

ITodoListUser.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating the authenticated user's todo list user account (todo_list_users).

May contain new email or password, or both, to update the currently authenticated user's own account. Fields are optional: at least one must be provided to effect any change. Only allows modifications to user-initiated fields—does not allow privilege elevation, account locking, or updates to system-managed fields. Updated_at is set automatically. Forbidden for any user to update another user's account.

Email and password fields are independently optional. If neither is provided or both are unchanged, the update has no effect. Email must be globally unique; password is only set if provided and meets security criteria. Account locking and ownership modifications are not permitted.

page.description: Page number for paginated session result set. Begins at 1 for the first page. Choose a reasonable value to retrieve more session records or browse a large user session history. Not required for unpaginated queries.

limit.description: Maximum number of session records to return in one page. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. Used for efficient paging and large history review; defaults enforced by backend if omitted.

search.description: Optional text search keyword for filtering sessions by client metadata, IP address, or other session attributes. Enables quick narrowing to specific contexts. Typically matches partial IP, device, or origin information; behavior determined by server implementation.

oneOf.description: Session attribute to sort the results by. Choose either session creation time or expiration time, if sorting is supported by the backend. Allowed values: 'created_at', 'expired_at'. Not required unless the session review scenario calls for specific sorting.

ITodoListUserSession.IRequest.description:
DTO for searching and paginating the session list for todo list user authentication sessions (todo_list_user_sessions).

Provides parameters to filter, paginate, or sort session audit logs when reviewing sessions associated with a user account. Used only in a privileged administrative context for compliance and security investigations.

All fields are optional. Pagination, search, and sort are controlled independently. Defaults are server-configured. If omitted, all sessions for the user may be returned, sorted by default order.

ITodoListUserSession.description:
Represents an authentication session for an end user in the Todo List system.

Each session encapsulates the authentication context for a particular user, including origin IP, access URL, referrer, and session lifecycle timestamps. Sessions are used for security auditing, token validation, and concurrent device support. This schema is based on the todo_list_user_sessions table, providing full traceability for admin oversight and forensic analysis. Related to todo_list_users for ownership and user linkage. Expired sessions are marked by a filled expired_at value.

Returned as detailed read DTO for administrative inspection; never modifiable by ordinary users.

id.description: Unique session identifier (primary key). Used to reference the session unambiguously within the system.

todo_list_user_id.description: Foreign key referencing the session-owning user. Links to the id field of todo_list_users. Used to associate session records to specific users for accountability and lifecycle management.

ip.description: IP address that originated the authentication session, used for security auditing and anomaly detection.

href.description: Original connection URL for the session, providing context on where the user initiated authentication.

referrer.description: Referrer URL at the point of login or session creation; essential for context, analytics, and security compliance.

created_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) for when the session was initiated and authentication occurred.

expired_at.description: UTC timestamp for session expiration—null if session is currently active. Used for session lifecycle management, forced logouts, and audit.

ITodoListAdmin.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for administrator search, list, or filter API endpoints.

Used for PATCH /todoList/admin/admins to provide flexible querying, pagination, and advanced filtering over todo_list_admins. Supports search by email, filter by lock status, and sorting by audit timestamps. Enables RBAC-protected admin discovery while enforcing least-privilege principles.

No authentication/credential properties appear here—only search/filter fields, pagination, and sort controls.

email.description: Optional partial or exact search filter for admin email address. Supports advanced admin lookup by contact address.

is_locked.description: Optional filter flag indicating locked/suspended admin accounts only (true) or only active ones (false).

page.description: Zero-based or one-based page index for paginated result traversal.

limit.description: Page size; maximum allowed results per page is 100.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort admin results. Allowed values are created_at, updated_at, and email.
Field by which to sort admin results. Allowed values are created_at, updated_at, and email.
Field by which to sort admin results. Allowed values are created_at, updated_at, and email.

Sort order direction—ascending (asc) or descending (desc)—for the chosen sort_by field.

ITodoListAdmin.description:
Administrator account entity for the Todo List service.

Represents a privileged user with administrative rights and responsibility for oversight, platform configuration, privileged operations, and audit tasks within the Todo List application. Admin accounts are identified by unique UUIDs and have key properties for authentication, contact, and security status. Excludes sensitive fields such as password hashes from responses to comply with security policies. Used for admin management, compliance review, and operational control.

id.description: Unique UUID identifier of the administrator account. Primary key from the todo_list_admins table.

email.description: Administrator's unique contact email. Used for login and notifications. Must be unique across all admin accounts.

is_locked.description: Indicates whether the admin account is locked and disallowed from performing actions. Used for security suspension and access revocation.

created_at.description: Date and time when the admin account was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the admin account, for audit and compliance purposes.

ITodoListAdmin.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating administrator account information in the Todo List service.

Allows modification of admin properties such as email, password, and lock status. Conforms to business rules: unique email, strong password requirements, and RBAC access controls. Does not permit modification of immutable identity fields. All updates are logged for compliance and audit.

email.description: New administrator email address. Must be unique among admins.

password.description: New plain-text password for the administrator. Required if password is being changed. The backend will hash and securely store the password; client may never send pre-hashed passwords.

is_locked.description: Flag for locking or unlocking the administrator account. Set to true to temporarily suspend admin capabilities due to security or compliance concerns.

ITodoListAdminSession.description: Administrator authentication session record from todo_list_admin_sessions. Used for audit, compliance, and security investigation.

id.description: Primary identifier of the session. Globally unique session ID, managed by the authentication system.

todo_list_admin_id.description: Foreign key identifier for the owning administrator. References the corresponding admin's unique ID from the todo_list_admins table.

ip.description: IP address from which the admin authenticated for this session. Used for audit trails and security monitoring.

href.description: URL at which the session originated (e.g., login page). Used for context and compliance tracking.

referrer.description: Referrer URL that led to the session's origin. Important for reconstructing session navigation chains in audits.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the session was created and authentication succeeded. This timestamp is precise to the second for audit accuracy.

oneOf.description: UTC time this session expired; null if session is still in progress.
Null value indicates session is active and not yet expired.

expired_at.description: Timestamp or null, marking when this session ended or when it still remains active.

ITodoListAdminSession.IRequest.description: Criteria for listing and filtering admin session records. For use with audit endpoints supporting advanced search, pagination, and compliance review.

Used for lightweight overviews in admin session listings and audit logs. Excludes detailed user relationships; reference to admin is not included in summary variant.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each todo item.

description.description: Todo task description, maximum 255 characters. Cannot be empty or whitespace only. Must be unique for user within duplicate suppression interval.

completed.description: Completion state of the todo. True if completed, false if incomplete.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated (description or completed status).

ITodoListTodo.description:
Main table for user-owned todo items following strict ownership policy.

Defines individual todos with required description, completion status, timestamps, and ownership linked directly to the user. Enforces business rules for CRUD, soft/hard delete, and status toggling. Supports API filtering by completion and deleted state. Titles and descriptions are validated for length, content, and duplication. Each todo is owned by exactly one user and cannot be accessed or modified by others except admins via compliance interfaces. Soft delete logic enforces 2-minute undo for user deletions, immediate permanent deletion by admins. Temporal fields track creation, last update, soft deletion, and completion timestamps. Only users may create todos; admins cannot own personal tasks.

page.description:
Pagination page number. 1-based index for paginated requests.

Defaults to 1 if not specified. Used to retrieve successive pages of todo summaries when filtering large result sets.

limit.description:
Page size limit for pagination. Maximum value is 100.

Specifies how many todo summaries per page should be returned. Used to prevent excessive data transfer and enable efficient UIs.

completed.description:
If specified, restrict results to only completed (true) or incomplete (false) todos.

Used for filtered task lists. Null or omission disables completion-status filtering.

search.description:
A full-text, partial, or keyword query to match against todo descriptions.

Used for searching or filtering todos based on task content. Maximum 255 character length, as with descriptions.

include_deleted.description:
If true, include soft-deleted (recently removed but not yet erased) todos in results.

When omitted or false, soft-deleted todos are excluded unless they are within the user's undo period or subject to admin review.

ITodoListTodo.IRequest.description:
Search/filtering/query criteria and pagination options for the todo list.

Consists of optional filters (completion state, full-text description query, soft-delete inclusion), page, and size selectors. Applied exclusively to the authenticated user's todo list entries; access to others' todos is not possible except via admin-specific endpoints. Pagination and search constraints prevent abuse and ensure performance.

description.description: Todo task description, maximum 255 characters. Cannot be empty or whitespace only. Must be unique for user within duplicate suppression interval.

completed.description: Initial completion state of the todo. True if completed on creation, false if incomplete.

ITodoListTodo.ICreate.description:
Information required to create a new todo item, including description and completion status.

The requester must be an authenticated user. System-managed fields (timestamps, owner) are handled automatically. Description is required, up to 255 characters, non-empty and unique within suppression interval. The completed field must be specified at creation.

description.description: Todo task description, maximum 255 characters. Cannot be empty or whitespace only. Must be unique for user within duplicate suppression interval.

completed.description: Updated completion state. If set, completion timestamp changes accordingly.

ITodoListTodo.IUpdate.description:
Payload specifying updates to the todo, such as new description or completed status.

Fields are optional; only present fields will be updated. The requester must own the todo or have admin privileges. Business rules and validation constraints from the schema are enforced on update.

ITodoListTodoAuditLog.description:
Audit log entry for a privileged or destructive action on a todo item, supporting compliance and historical traceability.

Represents an immutable audit record linked to a specific todo item, describing what action occurred, who performed it (user or admin), when, and a contextual message for review. Enables post-incident forensics, compliance verification, and privileged operation audits. Only visible to system administrators—never end users. Used in compliance dashboards, operational review tools, and incident investigation systems.

All fields reflect immutable facts at the time of recording. This entity is append-only; records are never altered or deleted.

See related types: ITodoListTodoAuditLog.ISummary for summary views, ITodoListTodoAuditLog.IRequest for filter/search request, ITodoListTodoAuditLog.IInvert for listing by actor.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique audit log entry identifier. Used for traceability and API access to specific audit events.

todo_id.description: Foreign key referencing the affected todo item. Ensures referential integrity for which todo the audit event applies to.

actor_user_id.description: Foreign key to the acting user who performed the action, if user-based. Null if the action was performed by an admin only.

actor_admin_id.description: Foreign key to the acting admin, if the action was performed by an administrator. Null otherwise.

action.description: Action type captured by the log. Allowed values: created, updated, completed, uncompleted, deleted, restored, admin_deleted, admin_edited. Used to categorize operation for compliance and review.

context.description: Optional freeform context string providing rich detail for audits: input data, reason for action, technical context, etc. May be null when no extra information is available.

created_at.description: The UTC timestamp for when the audit event was recorded, in ISO 8601 date-time format. Immutable.

ITodoListTodoAuditLog.IRequest.description:
Filter and pagination parameters for searching audit logs related to a specific todo item.

Used strictly by administrative users for forensic investigation, compliance review, or operational audits of privileged or destructive actions on a todo. Supports filtering by actor (user or admin), action type, and audit log timestamp. Enables targeted review of immutable historical records for post-incident analysis.

Combines search constraints with pagination controls for integration with admin dashboards and compliance dashboards. Not exposed to or usable by end users under any circumstances.

actor_user_id.description: Optional user actor ID to filter audit logs by actions performed by a specific user. Use null to indicate no user filter.

actor_admin_id.description: Optional admin actor ID to filter audit logs by actions by a specific admin. Use null to indicate no admin filter.

action.description: Optional filter by action type (created, updated, completed, uncompleted, deleted, restored, admin_deleted, admin_edited). Null for no action-type filter.

after.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for audit log created_at datetime filtering. ISO 8601 format. Null to ignore lower bound.

before.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for audit log created_at datetime filtering. ISO 8601 format. Null to ignore upper bound.

page.description: Page index for paginated results. Starts from 1. Used for browsing large sets of audit logs.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page in audit log paginated results. Used for efficient page-by-page querying. Maximum 100.
